summary: Soft-deleted users still authenticate via requireUser()
description:
Clerk webhook sets users.deleted_at on deletion (soft delete), but src/lib/auth.ts requireUser() runs:

  SELECT id, email, tier, stripe_customer_id FROM users WHERE id = $1

without filtering deleted_at IS NOT NULL. A deleted user keeps full app access until their Clerk session expires.

Fix: add `AND deleted_at IS NULL` to the requireUser() query. Consider whether other queries that look users up by id should also exclude soft-deleted rows.

Severity: HIGH — auth bypass.

resolution.test_function: filters soft-deleted users (deleted_at IS NULL) and returns 401 when row is absent
resolution.note: Added AND deleted_at IS NULL to requireUser query. Other user-by-id lookups (clerk webhook, stripe webhook) intentionally left unguarded — see commit message context.
